claims.text: The evaluation of the generated text includes the word error rate (WER), which measures the edit distance between generated text and corrected variants, with a WER of 5.6%.
The generated text was evaluated using BLEU score, achieving a score of 19.67 on the test set, which compares the generated text to reference texts.
Human evaluations assessed the acceptability of the output for production use, focusing on usability and the need for post-editing.
